diagnostic_gates.training_necessary: Both seeds: h0 held12/12 AND h2 matched b1/b2 Held plus correct all InDrawer and drawer simultaneously12/12. This is an internal mechanism gate, not original-guide acceptance.
diagnostic_gates.development_generalizing_support: Both seeds must improve complete h2 pair correctness AND complete paired3-step-prefix over prior paired b1+b2 control; h0 held and h2 true-A-InDrawer retention must not regress. Report failure of any component; no post-hoc relaxed gate.

diagnostic_gates.predictive_meaning: Pre-h2 prior must be identical across hidden-fault pair; do not demand advance prediction of exogenous noise. Count prior-to-posterior corrections and regressions, pair discrimination, past relation retention, then actual post-h2 consequences.

control: Previous paired b1+b2, two1000-update fits. Reuse after source/schedule/initialization and candidate dev-score checks.
effect_scope: Observation route plus262144 new parameters. Not an isolated causal claim that h dominance alone is responsible. Does not change loss or remove valid uncertain-prior supervision. No independent readout head.
h0_scope: initial() has h=0 exactly as before; no explicit new observation-to-h path at h0. Shared training may still affect h0, evaluated separately.
budget: Two1000-update fits only; 1200second training cap; no follow-on training.
